status: DRAFT until docs/plans/prereg_kroc2027_A_v1.md is committed; then frozen (changes need a new file)
plan: KROC2027 plan v2, package P1 approved by the user on 2026-10-14

policy.label: Policy F (ep25000, riskcap governor), evaluated unchanged
policy.note: The launcher is run byte-for-byte; every KROC2027 setting reaches the task through NAVRL_KROC2027_* variables it does not touch.

hardware.never_pool_with: results from the GTX 1650 Ti host (GPU4GB=1)

evaluation.primary_metric: capture: swept segment distance below 0.5 m (capture_0p5m), unchanged
evaluation.estimand: per-environment quota: the first 16 completed episodes of each of 128 environments; later episodes are kept as NONPRIMARY_TAIL and never used
evaluation.exogenous_streams: UNPAIRED_STREAM: arms are independent samples from one sampler; seed labels are blocking labels, not episode pairing

target_models.historical_reference: H_historical (not run in KROC2027; legacy reflection and push-out paths)

moving_model_rule: The first candidate in order whose canary motion gates (G1, G2, swept clearance, wall) all PASS becomes the moving model for A3/A4 and B. E1 and E2 share the bounded executor, so an executor defect fails both. If none passes, A3/A4 are not run and H-A2 is NOT_TESTED; a new motion lineage needs its own approval.

initial_view.altitude: pursuer and target both at task_config.flight_altitude
initial_view.clearance_rule: the drone-spawn footprint rule (_spawn_footprint_clearance_accepted with _spawn_required_surface_margin_m) against every solid obstacle, for every arm
initial_view.los_rule: centre ray from the camera, with the camera facing the target, clear of every solid obstacle box (3D slab test); identical for both views
initial_view.treatment: visible: camera boresight on the target; hidden: pursuer turned 180 degrees. Hidden means outside the field of view, not occluded.

variables.NAVRL_KROC2027_RECORDER: 1 to record; unset or 0 for off

camera.mount: level, on the yaw-only vehicle frame

recorder.ground_truth_use: evaluation sidecar only; never the actor observation

motion_gate.collision: swept segment of the target centre against every solid obstacle footprint: distance at or above target_proxy_radius_m; target centre inside the arena bounds
motion_gate.on_violation: stop the run; keep the first violation of each gate with its state and episode key

checks: off_path_reproduces_replication_cell: E0_static, 70 bars, seed 4104, every NAVRL_KROC2027_* variable unset, episode ledger on: result.json identical to results/target_motion_replication_7seed/E0_static__70bars__seed4104/result.json except the run nonce
recorder_noninterference: A1 treatment, 70 bars, seed 4190, recorder off and on with the trajectory digest on: identical result.json except the nonce, identical trajectory digest
motion_gates: A3 and A4 with E2_obstacle_aware and with E1_cv at all four densities: G1, G2, swept clearance and wall PASS
instrumentation: A1 and A2 at all four densities: one recorder record per ledger episode, outcomes agree, import origins inside the hashed tree
initial_view_acceptance: acceptance rounds and pursuer respawns recorded per density; no fail-closed abort
b1_integrity (only if B1 code is merged before the canary): supervisor on, hidden arm, 115 and 205 bars: priority chain, suppression and feedback records consistent; outcomes not inspected
timing: seconds per cell for the scale rule
canary.outcomes_not_used: canary capture, crash and timeout counts are recorded and never used for any decision

experiment_A.scale_rule: Before the main run, project A hours as the sum over cells of canary seconds per quota episode x 16 for the matching arm and density. If the projection exceeds 30 h - canary hours used - 4.9 h (B at two densities, stressed, plus smoke) - 2.0 h reserve, A runs at 115 and 205 bars only. Decided from timing only.

analysis_A.aggregation: per seed, the four density cells weighted equally; inference unit = seed (n = 7)
analysis_A.primary_test: two-sided paired t over seeds (df = 6); Holm over the family

predicted_direction.basis: already-observed exploratory data (docs/plans/kroc2027_pilot_v1.json); tests stay two-sided

analysis_A.sensitivity: BCa 95 % (20000 resamples, seed 4200) and exact sign-flip p, both from tools/target_motion_replication.py, unmodified
analysis_A.never_substituted: a never-acquired latency is null, never 0

experiment_B.conditional_on: the gate below, evaluated once after the A analysis
experiment_B.arm_rule: the hidden arm (A2 static or A4 moving) with the larger never-acquired failure rate (never acquired and crash or timeout, over all quota episodes, seed-level mean); a difference within 0.5 pp selects static

conditions.B0: Policy F unchanged on the selected hidden arm
conditions.B1: Policy F plus the external yaw-scanning supervisor (default off; NAVRL_KROC2027_SEARCH=b1)

experiment_B.density_rule: four densities if remaining GPU hours minus the stressed four-density B estimate minus the 0.25 h smoke leave at least 2.0 h; otherwise 115 and 205 bars
gate: 2: in the selected arm pair, visible minus hidden capture and ever-acquired differences both have 95 % paired-t intervals above 0
3: in the selected hidden arm, never-acquired failures exceed 50 % of failures
4: remaining GPU hours cover the planned B hours plus 1.0 h retry
5: B preregistration committed and the B run approved
experiment_B.primary: capture(B1) - capture(B0), two-sided paired t over seeds, alpha 0.05 (single test)
experiment_B.adoption: a Pareto improvement: capture up with crash and timeout not up (95 % interval upper bounds at or below 0 pp); a simulation criterion, not a flight-safety guarantee

supervisor.initial_trigger: 1.0 s after reset with no fused measurement and no active track
supervisor.track_lost_trigger: tracker inactive after its own expiry; a single missed frame never triggers
supervisor.scan_direction: balanced left/right from the episode key; never from ground truth
supervisor.translation: XY command 0 while searching; altitude hold unchanged
supervisor.suppression: no scan yaw and XY 0 when LiDAR surface clearance is at or below the hard margin or invalid
supervisor.return: next command after a fused measurement with an active track
supervisor.priority: policy -> supervisor -> existing speed governor -> final command -> feedback
supervisor.risk_noted: 0.6 rad/s is one fifth of the policy's 3.0 rad/s limit; turning a target from behind to the field-of-view edge takes about 4.0 s, so B1 can slow acquisition where the policy turns faster

gpu_budget_hours.basis: existing RTX 3070 cells.csv throughput x 1.25, or the Monte Carlo stress (hidden timeouts doubled, B1 scan +45 steps), whichever is larger

stop_rules: any hash, schema, receipt or import-origin mismatch
any motion-gate, swept-clearance or wall violation
an incomplete quota or a recorder record missing for a quota episode
never: replacing a seed or deleting a cell because results look unfavourable
